summary: Frontend mobile verification completed: demo login and mobile menu open/close work; root still reports 8px horizontal overflow.

issues: document/body scrollWidth equals viewport, but #root scrollWidth is 398px, indicating an 8px internal horizontal overflow despite overflow-x hidden.

action_items: Inspect the dashboard child causing #root scrollWidth to exceed 390px; ensure no internal element is wider than the mobile viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: html/body/#root overflow-x:hidden masks document scrolling but does not remove the underlying #root 398px layout width; identify the overflowing child rather than relying only on clipping.
seed_data_creation: None; used the app's local demo login with non-empty values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 390x844, demo-user/demo-password reaches dashboard. Menu opens and closes when scrim is clicked at an exposed edge (x=380); center scrim is covered by the fixed sidebar as expected. document/body scrollWidth=390, #root scrollWidth=398.
rca of the issue: The app clips document/body overflow, but a dashboard descendant makes #root's scrollable layout 8px wider than the viewport. The exact descendant was not isolated in this run; inspect element widths/box shadows and mobile grid sizing.
